common.name: Name
login.title: Welcome to RechnungFlow
login.subtitle: Sign in to your invoice workspace.
login.hint: Use the credentials printed at first startup. Demo accounts share the generated demo password.
login.hero:
From invoice to approval.
Nothing lost along the way.
login.description: A deliberate workflow for incoming e-invoices, supplier checks, separated approvals, and accounting handoff.
login.preview: Engineering preview · Not certified accounting software
demo.banner: DEMO WORKSPACE — Synthetic data. Sandbox exports only. No official validation or payment claims.
strict.banner: Strict mode: official KoSIT acceptance and business controls are required before approval.
dashboard.title: A clear view of every invoice.
dashboard.subtitle: Review exceptions, keep approvals moving, and hand off with evidence.
dashboard.priorityReview: Complete business checks before requesting approval.
dashboard.priorityException: Invalid documents and unresolved risks stay blocked.
dashboard.priorityExport: Check delivery status and reconcile uncertain outcomes.
dashboard.separation: Uploader, reviewer, and approver are separated
dashboard.explain: A successful technical check does not prove a real delivery, a correct tax treatment, or authority to pay.
invoices.title: Invoice inbox
invoices.subtitle: Every original, validation result, and decision in one case.
invoices.approvalSubtitle: Make a recorded decision on a reviewed invoice.
upload.title: Import structured invoices
upload.description: Select UBL Invoice, UBL CreditNote, or CII XML files. Maximum 2 MiB per file. PDF-only and hybrid PDF extraction are not supported in this release.
upload.original: The original is never overwritten. Corrections create a linked case.
upload.duplicate: Exact duplicate: the existing case was returned.
upload.correctHint: This submission replaces the current unapproved case, preserving its original and history.
detail.revalidateNote: Revalidation updates the validation evidence, never the original XML.
detail.holdHelp: A hold prevents retention cleanup. It is not a payment block. This release does not automatically delete originals.
detail.actionsUnavailable: No action is available for your role at this stage.
detail.selfApproval: Independent review and approval are enforced by the server.
suppliers.title: Verified supplier records
suppliers.subtitle: Bank details are not silently learned from incoming invoices.
suppliers.identityHint: Use the exact extracted identity, for example taxId:DE123456789.
suppliers.confirm: I verified the identity and bank details through a trusted, independent channel.
suppliers.changeWarning: Changes require a new independent verification and invalidate affected pending approvals.
suppliers.creatorBlocked: A different user must verify this change.
jobs.title: Accounting handoff
jobs.subtitle: Durable delivery records. Uncertain outcomes require reconciliation, not blind retries.
jobs.warning: Check the accounting destination first. A timeout does not prove that the invoice was not recorded.
jobs.unconfigured: No external accounting destination is configured. Demo exports use the local sandbox ledger.
audit.title: A traceable decision history
audit.subtitle: Hash-linked events document what happened. This is not a certified or independently anchored archive.
users.title: People & service access
users.subtitle: Assign the minimum role needed. Disabling a user invalidates their sessions.
users.passwordHint: New users must change their initial password on first sign-in.
keys.title: Intake API keys
keys.once: Copy this secret now. It will not be displayed again.
keys.scope: Upload and read own cases only. No approval, export, or administration rights.
policy.title: Approval rules, explicitly versioned
policy.subtitle: A policy snapshot is attached at intake. Later changes do not silently lower existing requirements.
policy.name: Workspace name
policy.note: Retention dates are planning aids, not legal advice. No automatic deletion is implemented. Configure your actual legal and contractual obligations.
system.title: Operational readiness
system.subtitle: Know which components are configured and which acceptance checks remain.
system.kositHelp: Run scripts/setup_kosit.py on a network-enabled development machine. Review the release assets and manifest before enabling strict validation.
system.boundaryText: Live validator acceptance, security review, restoration rehearsals, accounting integration acceptance, and legal/process review remain deployment responsibilities.
docs.title: Documentation, in your language
docs.subtitle: Setup, business workflow, API contracts, operations, and verification boundaries.
